Confidence Score: 5/5

The PR appears safe to merge; the final-head collision guard preserves ambiguous source-owned rules while retaining the intended fallback for the audited Light road labels.

Summary

 This PR restores the audited Mapbox Light English/local fallback for two road-label rules while preserving source eligibility and native rendering settings. - Applies `coalesce("name_en", "name")` only to the expected Light road rules and existing place-label owners. - Declines the road repair when source ownership or layout contracts are ambiguous, including generated-band ID collisions. - Adds focused unit and QGIS-backed coverage for content evaluation, eligibility, native settings, idempotence, and collision behavior. - Documents the scoped correction and its remaining visual-fidelity limitations.

 ```mermaid %%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%% flowchart LR Source[Mapbox Light source style] --> Validate{Exact audited road owner?} Validate -->|No| Preserve[Leave native fields unchanged] Validate -->|Yes| Collision{Generated-band ID source-owned?} Collision -->|Yes| Preserve Collision -->|No| Converted[Converted QGIS label rules] Converted --> Match{Expected road rule and field is name?} Match -->|No| Preserve Match -->|Yes| Fallback[Apply coalesce name_en, name] ```
